subject: Rename TLS test cert files to valkey (#186)
reason: The change only renames TLS test certificate filenames (redis.* to valkey.*) in documentation, the TCL test harness, hiredis's test script, and the cert-generation helper script. No file under src/ changes, so no server, replication, TLS runtime, command, or tool behavior is affected; there is nothing a fuzzer scenario could reach or break.
